key_insight: Pymatgen’s 15-year evolution illustrates how community-driven, open-source software can sustain and advance computational materials science workflows.
engineering_relevance: Pymatgen provides an established foundation for materials computation and informatics, with continued utility dependent on adapting to changing workflow needs.
method: Review 15 years of community growth and development practices.
Describe current functionality supporting advanced materials workflows.
Discuss maintenance challenges, potential solutions, and future directions.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a qualitative retrospective but reports no quantitative benchmarks, datasets, or AI model evaluations.
watch_item: Managing community-driven growth while adapting to rapidly changing computational needs remains an ongoing maintenance challenge.
paper_title: pymatgen: 15 years of community growth, new functionality, and future prospects
